-- Rollback discards only technical scheduling metadata. Facts, ACKs and the
-- preexisting attempts counter remain; the identity/payload trigger stays active.
DROP INDEX IF EXISTS practice_student_evidence_outbox_retry_idx;
ALTER TABLE practice_student_evidence_outbox
    DROP COLUMN IF EXISTS last_failure_code,
    DROP COLUMN IF EXISTS next_attempt_at,
    DROP COLUMN IF EXISTS last_attempt_at;
